child_tool_info.description: Measure aligned residues, substitutions, gaps and coverage between supplied sequences using BV-BRC Homology BLAST with an explicitly evidenced single-sequence reference.
child_tool_info.instructions: Supply the query and exactly one reference sequence, with source-backed sequence identities, lengths, molecule types and evidence that the submitted reference population contains only that sequence. One returned hit does not establish a pairwise experiment. Pass the original reference input and its retained member/inventory source through the results selector supplied_metadata. The deterministic check compares complete submitted FASTA, sequence digest, length, molecule and actual native hit identifiers. For retained reference files, supply a source-backed {content, text} value containing the original ContentBinding and complete FASTA text; a remote path alone is insufficient. Any explicit member-to-native mapping must retain its exact native ordinals and ID. Retain every HSP and its actual coordinate correspondence, including translated units, strand, overlapping positions, substitutions and gaps. Coverage uses unique paired positions divided by the full corresponding operand length; span coverage has a different meaning. Keep native alignment scores, but do not use database E-value as paired-sequence relevance. No database function-weight model applies to this mode. Use the existing launch episode and its selected API child for the original Homology assignment; the supplied invocation contract also includes the existing results assignment. The version field distinguishes these two actual commission payloads. Select native blastp, blastn, blastx, tblastn or tblastx and explicit native input/database parameters. api.bvbrc_appservice.prepare validates the original application and inputs without submitting. workspace_metadata, workspace_create and upload provide separately selected preparation or transfer operations when needed. submit performs the selected start_app2 request and retains its original task identity. Monitoring uses the existing monitor episode and separately selected query_tasks, stdout or stderr observations; logs do not declare execution state, and no polling schedule is prescribed. The results episode can select task_info, workspace_metadata, list_outputs, download_capability and download to acquire the original task manifest and actual output bytes. Preserve original task, Workspace path/UUID and manifest associations. An HTML report, basename or JSON suffix does not identify the numerical format. Declare the actual raw BLAST JSON, transformed Homology JSON or tabular representation and required fields; opaque archives remain unparsed. The bound deterministic parser fills the numerical sheet, and a separate calculator supplies requested quantities during the selected acquisition action. Saved sheets permit explicit recalculation without another service call. Request only the needed numerical fields or conditional distributions through the typed Homology return sources. Full bytes, sheets and components remain retained. Missing inputs become explicit acquisition requirements; partial, failed, unknown and measured zero remain distinct. This library information grants no direct scientific execution and does not establish live service authentication, deployment or annotation correctness.
child_tool_info.name: bvbrc.homology.pairwise_correspondence
